capture.title: Capture output device
capture.guidance: For capture by streaming or recording software; set separately from local listening.
capture.volumeHint: Applies to vocals and BGM; the 50% default leaves headroom and doesn't change monitor or guide levels.

modal.title: Choose capture output device
modal.help: How to choose a capture device
modal.description: Choose the output device your streaming or recording software captures. It applies right away.
modal.empty: No available devices. Install a virtual audio device first.

guide.title: Virtual audio tools
guide.intro: Lets Utawakui send the backing track straight to your streaming or recording software, without physical cables.
guide.license: Both are licensed as Donationware: you choose what to contribute based on your use. Professional or organizational use has separate paid licensing requirements, so check the official terms first.

tools.vbCable: Sends one app's sound to another; suited to a single source.
tools.voicemeeter: Mixes several sources, such as a microphone and backing track, before output.
